name: Animated Counter
description: Provides animated number counters (count-up animation) as a block.
project_description:
Animated Counter provides a flexible and visually engaging way to display key statistics, achievements, or metrics using animated number counters. The module allows site builders and content editors to create and manage multiple counters through a configurable block, with built-in animation, layout controls, styling options, and live preview.

 ✨ Features 

 
 Counter Management 
 
 Add unlimited counters from the block configuration UI 
 Remove counters dynamically 
 Configure value, label, suffix, and animation speed 
 Optional icon support for each counter 
 Live preview inside the admin form 
 
 
 Animation & Behavior 
 
 Smooth counting animation from 0 to target value 
 Configurable animation duration (speed) 
 Supports suffixes (%, +, etc.) 
 Scroll-triggered animation (runs when visible) 
 
 
 Layout & Design 
 
 Automatic column layout based on number of tiles 
 Admin option to force 2, 3, or 4 columns 
 Equal-height tiles for consistent layout 
 Fully responsive:
 
 Desktop: configured layout 
 Tablet: 2 columns 
 Mobile: 1 column 
 
 
 
 
 Style Presets 
 
 Choose from built-in visual styles:
 
 Card 
 Bordered 
 Minimal 
 
 
 
 
 Admin Experience 
 
 Live preview updates instantly while editing 
 No need to save to see changes 
 Works with Claro and Gin admin themes 
 
 
 Use Cases 
 
 Showcase business achievements 
 Highlight KPIs and metrics 
 Display milestones and statistics 
 Marketing landing pages 
 SaaS performance indicators 
 Case study highlights
